data.title: How will Barcelona line up against Getafe? - Yahoo Sports
data.content: Barcelona look to continue their history-making perfect start to the season and make it eight wins out of eight in *La Liga* as the leaders face Getafe at Camp Nou. Here's how we think Hansi Flick will line up his troops for Saturday's battle:. Barça worked very hard in the summer to build a very deep and versatile squad, and this is the time to take advantage as the Catalans begin a brutal two-week stretch with a home match against Getafe, then three massive away games in a row followed by *El Clásico* in a sequence that will truly test the depth and quality of Flick's squad. Eric Garcia is over a minor issue that caused him to leave the Spain camp during the international break, but Flick is unlikely to take any risks and will start **Jules Kounde** at right-back. We still think Flick will be careful with Pedri and have him on the bench to start this one, with **Gavi** likely to take his place after spending the entire break in Catalonia.

According to the source, the official announcement of the deal will be made this week.
